in_hindi.name: गोविंदराज
in_hindi.long_meaning: गोविंद (Govinda, God) + राज (Raja, King) = शरण लागू होने वाले गोविंद (Govindaraj, One who protects Govinda)

in_marathi.name: Govindaraj
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of Cows
in_marathi.long_meaning: Govindaraj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Govindaraj is a combination of two Sanskrit words: ‘Govinda’ meaning 'Lord of Cows' and ‘Raj’ meaning 'Ruler' or 'King'. This name is associated with Lord Krishna, who is often depicted as the protector of cows. In Hindu mythology, Krishna is considered to be the eighth avatar of Lord Vishnu.

in_bengali.name: Govindaraj
